defects: Uses `Cardinal.toENat` (ℕ∞-valued extended natural cast, sending infinite cardinals to ⊤) instead of `Cardinal.toNat` (ℕ-valued truncation, sending infinite cardinals to 0) as required by the gold/informal statement — different function and different codomain, not a mere notational variant
Hypothesis compares n with the truncated/cast value `c.toENat` rather than with the raw cardinal `c` itself as in gold's `n ≤ c`, changing the logical structure of the hypothesis

Conclusion asserts equality of `toENat` values (in ℕ∞) rather than equality of `toNat` values (in ℕ) as in gold — a different final proposition even if plausibly equivalent under the hypothesis, which is not established with high confidence here
Drops gold's cross-universe generality (c : Cardinal.{u}, d : Cardinal.{v}) — produced statement requires c₁, c₂ to live in the same universe
